duplicates.title: Duplicate meals
duplicates.description: People entitled to the same meal under more than one role
duplicates.info: One person can be a volunteer, an artist and an organiser at the same time: each role opens the meals separately, so they count several times in the total sent to the kitchen and require as many check-ins at the desk. Nothing is removed automatically — it is up to you to decide, person by person, which roles keep the meal.
duplicates.none: No duplicates: nobody is entitled to the same meal under more than one role.
duplicates.no_right: The “{source}” permission is required: this must be handled by whoever is in charge of it.
duplicates.confirm_description: {name} will no longer be expected or counted for their {count} meals as {source}. Their other roles are unchanged, and the removal can be undone from the relevant page.
duplicates.remove_error: Failed to remove the meal entitlement
duplicates.remove_forbidden: Insufficient permissions to change this source

meals.confirm_disable_description: The meal will disappear from the screens, the counter and the kitchen counts. Volunteer and artist answers, as well as meals already served, are KEPT: they will reappear unchanged if you re-enable the meal.

treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.subtitle: Expenses and income of the edition. Lines from artists and ticketing are corrected at their source.
treasury.code_error: Unable to save the code assignment
treasury.codes_help: Codes belong to the convention: they are reused from one edition to the next. Deleting a code removes it from the lines using it, without changing their amount.
treasury.entry_advanced_by_placeholder: Search for someone from the edition
treasury.entry_receipt_placeholder: Photograph the receipt, or drop a PDF invoice
treasury.reimbursed_error: Could not mark the advances as reimbursed
treasury.code_delete_confirm: The entries that used it will keep their amount and only lose their allocation. This action is permanent.
treasury.plan_description: Browse the accounts, then import the ones you need. You can change their label before confirming.
treasury.plan_open: Find a code in the French charts of accounts
treasury.open_receipt_new_tab: Open the receipt in a new tab
treasury.filtered_count: no rows shown | 1 row shown | {count} rows shown
treasury.filter_search_help: The search covers the label and the description, word by word in any order.
treasury.plan_search_help: Codes are matched from their beginning, labels anywhere.
treasury.amount_from_tiers_help: The amount will follow the sales of the chosen tiers, and will leave the “Ticketing — other income” line instead of adding to it.
treasury.reimburse_confirm_description: The {count} entries advanced by {nom}, totalling {montant}, will be marked as reimbursed all at once. To undo this, you will have to reopen each entry.
treasury.breakdown_subtitle: The total for each accounting code, across the whole edition. The individual entries stay on the income statement.
treasury.cash_float_available_help: What the till holds beyond what is still owed.
treasury.cash_float_count: Counted in the till at closing
treasury.cash_float_count_help: The amount read off when counting the till, not a calculation. Leave empty until it is done.
treasury.cash_float_delete_confirm: Delete the {montant} contribution from {preteur}? This affects no line of the income statement.
treasury.cash_float_empty: No contribution recorded for this edition.
treasury.cash_float_not_counted: The till has not been counted yet.
treasury.cash_float_note_placeholder: E.g. fives and tens for the bar
treasury.cash_float_notice: A cash float is neither an expense nor an income: the money is neither spent nor earned, it is lent and then returned. These amounts therefore appear neither in the income statement nor in the breakdown by account code. If a lender waives repayment, record a donation as income on the income statement.
treasury.cash_float_notice_title: Outside the income statement, on purpose
treasury.cash_float_subtitle: The cash lent to give change, and what is still owed to the lenders.
treasury.entry_payee_hint: The third party this expense should be paid to. Incompatible with an advance: if someone paid out of their own pocket, they are the one to reimburse.
treasury.entry_payee_none: Nobody — expense already settled or with no third party
treasury.payee_delete_confirm: Their bank details will be erased.
treasury.payee_iban_suspect: This IBAN looks incorrect. It will be saved anyway — check it before transferring.
treasury.payees_help: The people and companies the edition owes money to. Record them once with their bank details, then select them on your expenses.
treasury.payouts_help: What the edition owes third parties — providers, venues, suppliers. Not to be confused with advances, which are owed to team members who paid out of their own pocket.
